createOrReplace.title: International high schools - United Kingdom (British-patterned) | UBC
createOrReplace.excerpt: General: standing in at least six academic subject areas (GCSE, AS, A Levels), including English, with at least three academic A Levels or six AS Levels; minimum C in English Literature or English Language at GCSE, AS or A Level. Engineering: Math (A Level), Chemistry or Physics (A Level), Chemistry (GCSE), Physics (GCSE). Arts: no specific courses. Commerce: Mathematics (A or AS Level). Science: Math (A or AS Level), Chemistry (GCSE), Physics (GCSE). In past years, a B average (a combination of mainly A and B grades) on your country's grading scale was required; grades vary by degree and year.

createOrReplace.title: International high schools - United States (American curriculum) | UBC
createOrReplace.excerpt: General: graduation from an academic or college preparation program at a US regionally accredited school; English to the senior level; three years of mathematics to the junior level; minimum B- in an English course to at least the junior level. SAT or ACT: applicants who choose not to submit will not be disadvantaged. Engineering: Pre-Calculus, AP Chemistry (or two full years of Chemistry), AP Physics 2 or C. Arts: no specific courses. Commerce: Pre-Calculus. Science: Pre-Calculus, one year of Chemistry, one year of Physics. In past years, a B average was required.
